about: Templates for the H2S and VOC records. Copy each one into calibration_records.json ONLY after filling every null from that sensor's Alphasense factory calibration sheet. Do not use any value that is not on the factory sheet.

records.notes: From the ISB factory sheet: WE total zero (mV), AE total zero (mV), sensitivity (mV/ppb).
From the PID factory sheet: zero (mV) goes in we_zero_mv; sensitivity (mV/ppm).
